content: Open MIDI latency tools are Linux-centric: alsa-midi-latency-test (worst case, jitter histogram), x42 jack_midi_latency, jack2 midi_latency_test (avg/peak jitter, plot), midiclockwork (BT/WiFi clock spread), Schultz MIDI Benchmarking Toolbox (Arduino), Windows Latency Analysis Software. No macOS-native MIDI-to-sound tester found.
